download_fever_dataset: download the FEVER fact verification dataset train dev and test splits from fever.ai
create_fever_64shot_subset: create a 64-shot subset of the FEVER training data by filtering specific line indices
run_fever_preprocessing: run the FEVER dataset preprocessing script to download and prepare data for fact verification tasks
overwrite_fever_data: overwrite existing FEVER dataset files by running the script with the --overwrite flag
prepare_fever_for_fewshot: prepare the FEVER dataset for few-shot learning by extracting 64 training examples
